title: Understanding Training and Validation Error
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests that the model is generalizing better to unseen data. This often happens when the model is less complex, reducing overfitting.

title: Model Complexity and Error
text: A decrease in validation error with an increase in training error can indicate that the model complexity has been reduced, leading to better generalization.

title: Feature Selection Impact
text: By selecting fewer features, the model might become less complex, which can help in reducing overfitting and improving validation performance.
